sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LARGE SCALE PATTERN WILL REMAIN DOMINATED BY A LOW AMPLITUDE UPPER RIDGE OVER THE NRN PLAINS AND A TROUGH ADVANCING THROUGH THE WRN STATES. IMPULSE CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH SRN SASKATCHEWAN WILL TURN ESEWD TODAY INTO SRN ONTARIO AND NRN MN AS IT CRESTS UPPER RIDGE. THIS FEATURE WILL FORCE A SURFACE BOUNDARY SEWD THROUGH THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY DURING THE AFTERNOON. ANOTHER SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW APPROACHING THE PACIFIC NW WILL MOVE THROUGH THE NRN ROCKIES...REACHING THE NRN HIGH PLAINS LATER FRIDAY NIGHT. FARTHER SOUTH A REMNANT FRONTAL BOUNDARY WILL PERSIST FORM THE CAROLINAS WWD THROUGH THE TN VALLEY AREA.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS THROUGH UPPER MS VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES
sections.text: THE IMPULSE MOVING ESEWD THROUGH S-CNTRL CANADA WILL FORCE A WEAK FRONT SEWD THROUGH THE NRN PLAINS TODAY WHILE A CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED E-W BOUNDARY PERSISTS FROM NRN MN EWD INTO NRN WI. THE SWLY LOW LEVEL JET WILL VEER AND SHIFT EWD THROUGH THE UPPER MS VALLEY IN RESPONSE TO THE PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THIS FEATURE WILL TRANSPORT HIGHER THETA-E AIR NEWD THROUGH THE WARM SECTOR BENEATH STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES RESULTING IN 2000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE. A FEW STORMS MAY STILL BE ONGOING PRIMARILY NORTH OF BOUNDARY ACROSS NRN MN AND ND AT THE START OF THIS PERIOD. THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE ELEVATED WITH LIMITED SEVERE POTENTIAL. OTHER STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG AND AHEAD OF SEWD ADVANCING BOUNDARY FROM ERN SD INTO SRN MN AS THE ATMOSPHERE DESTABILIZES AND THE CAP WEAKENS. BELT OF STRONGER 60-70 KT MID LEVEL FLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE PROGRESSIVE IMPULSE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO 40-50 KT BULK SHEAR. INITIAL STORMS WILL LIKELY BE SUPERCELLULAR IN NATURE WITH A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL. WITH THE LOW LEVEL JET EXPECTED TO VEER WITH TIME...0-1 KM HODOGRAPHS WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY LARGE...BUT SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES THROUGH EARLY EVENING. STORMS ARE EXPECTED

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO ONCE AGAIN DEVELOP IN VICINITY OF STALLED BOUNDARY FROM THE CAROLINAS WWD INTO THE TN VALLEY AND SERN STATES. DESPITE WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR...STRONG INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR WET MICROBURSTS DURING THE AFTERNOON. HAVE INTRODUCED A SLIGHT RISK OVER THE CAROLINAS WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE WAS NOT OVERTURNED BY CONVECTION ON THURSDAY AND WHERE THE FRONT MAY RESULT IN A GREATER CONCENTRATION OF STORMS AND SEVERE EVENTS. ..DIAL/DEAN/JEWELL.. 06/25/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF NC AND SC
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... RELATIVELY PROGRESSIVE FLOW PATTERN WILL EXIST FROM THE WEST COAST ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS TO THE NORTHEAST TODAY. AT LEAST TWO SHORT WAVE TROUGHS EMBEDDED WITHIN A BAND OF FASTER MID LEVEL FLOW WILL DRIVE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM POTENTIAL FROM THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS EAST ACROSS THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY THROUGH TONIGHT. ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED ALONG A COLD FRONT...FROM NRN CA ACROSS THE NRN GREAT BASIN TO THE NRN ROCKIES...AS ANOTHER SHORT WAVE...NOW MOVING OVER CENTRAL CA...ENHANCES LIFT ALONG THE FRONT. WEAK DISTURBANCES INTERACTING WITH DIURNAL HEATING AND MID LEVEL MOISTURE PLUME WILL PROMOTE STORMS ACROSS THE NM/AZ BORDER AREA THIS AFTERNOON. TO THE SOUTH AND EAST...EXPANSIVE SUBTROPICAL RIDGE HAS WEAKENED IN THE PRESENCE OF CONVECTIVELY INDUCED SMALLER SCALE VORTICITY CENTERS AND ENCROACHMENT OF WEAK HEIGHT FALLS AND DECAYING FRONTAL ZONE FROM THE CAROLINAS WWD ACROSS THE TN/MS VALLEYS. WHILE AIR MASS OVER THESE AREAS REMAINS INFUSED WITH HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT AND POTENTIAL INSTABILITY...FLOW ALOFT WILL CONTINUE TO BE QUITE WEAK.

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS ACROSS MN TO NRN IA AND WI
sections.text: A LOW AMPLITUDE SHORT WAVE TROUGH...NEAR ND/MANITOBA BORDER ATTM...APPEARS TO BE DRIVING AN ARC OF STRONG TO ISOLD SEVERE STORMS OVER MN/NERN SD THIS MORNING. INTENSE UPDRAFTS WITHIN THE FLANKING PORTION OF THIS MCS ARE LIKELY BEING SUSTAINED BY LOW LEVEL MASS INFLOW AND DESTABILIZATION ON THE NOSE OF 50KT LOW LEVEL JET. IT IS NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR IF EARLY-DAY CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO EVOLVE...OR WHETHER IT WILL DECAY PRIOR TO NEW DEVELOPMENT INITIATING LATER THIS AFTERNOON. BUT...MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES MODEST HEIGHT FALLS WILL MAINTAIN LARGE SCALE ASCENT ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS AND MN INTO THIS AFTERNOON...COINCIDENT WITH STRONG DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION TO THE SOUTH AND WEST OF THE ONGOING ACTIVITY. MORNING STORMS AND CONVECTIVE DEBRIS WILL ACT TO REINFORCE THE WARM FRONT ACROSS THE AREA AND THIS BOUNDARY SHOULD BE THE FOCUS FOR NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT AS A WEAK SURFACE LOW TRACKS ENEWD FROM SD INTO MN LATER TODAY. THE WARM SECTOR AIRMASS WILL REMAIN CAPPED BY 10-12C 700MB TEMPS THROUGH MUCH OF THE AFTERNOON BUT PERSISTENT FORCING NEAR THE LOW AND FRONT...COMBINED WITH LARGER SCALE ASCENT ACROSS THE REGION...SHOULD RESULT IN SURFACE-BASED STORMS INITIATING FROM LATE AFTERNOON INTO

sections.title: CAROLINAS WWD ACROSS THE TN VALLEY TO THE SRN PLAINS
sections.text: HEATING OF THE DAY...WEAK CAP...AND VERY MOIST AIRMASS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO NUMEROUS STORMS FROM NC/SC ACROSS THE DEEP SOUTH AND WWD TO THE SRN PLAINS. REMNANTS OF STALLED FRONT...FROM THE CAROLINAS WWD INTO THE TN VALLEY...MAY HELP TO FOCUS SOME OF THIS DIURNALLY DRIVEN CONVECTION. A BAND OF WNWLY 15-20KT FLOW ALOFT...COUPLED WITH FRONT AND SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES ACROSS THE CAROLINAS...MAY CONTRIBUTE TO SOMEWHAT GREATER POTENTIAL FOR STORM ORGANIZATION/PERSISTENCE IN THESE AREAS. AFTERNOON WIND DAMAGE AND MAYBE SOME HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM THESE STORMS ELSEWHERE...WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR BUT STRONG INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT ISOLD/RANDOM WET MICROBURSTS DURING THE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: INTERIOR NORTHWEST/NRN ROCKIES
sections.text: SREF/NAM-WRF ARE FORECASTING THUNDERSTORMS TO INCREASE IN A SW-NE ORIENTED SWATH FROM NRN CA TO MT TODAY. WHILE CAPE IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG IN THIS CORRIDOR...LIFT/SHEAR ALONG THE FRONTAL ZONE...AND ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORT WAVE MOVING NEWD ACROSS THE GREAT BASIN...MAY ACT TO LOCALLY OVERCOME WEAK INSTABILITY TO SUPPORT A FEW PERSISTENT STORMS WITH MARGINAL HAIL AND WIND POTENTIAL. IT IS ALSO POSSIBLE THAT SOME OF THIS CONVECTION MAY PERSIST AS THE SHORT WAVE EMERGES OVER MT THROUGH EARLY SATURDAY MORNING. THERE IS SOME CHANCE FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL AS GREATER INSTABILITY IS REALIZED BY THESE STORMS.

sections.title: NM/AZ BORDER
sections.text: DIURNAL HEATING COUPLED WITH TRANSIENT MID LEVEL VORTICITY CENTER EMBEDDED WITHIN MOISTURE PLUME ON WRN FLANK OF SUBTROPICAL RIDGE WILL LIKELY AID IN AFTERNOON TSTM DEVELOPMENT IN THIS AREA. SOME POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR STRONG/GUSTY SURFACE WINDS AS STORMS MOVE OVER DEEPLY MIXED/DRY BOUNDARY LAYER. ..CARBIN/HURLBUT.. 06/25/2010

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS ACROSS MN TO NRN IA AND WI
sections.text: LEADING SHORTWAVE TROUGH...EMBEDDED WITHIN A BAND OF FASTER WLY MID LEVEL FLOW...WAS MOVING EWD THROUGH MN/ERN SD THIS MORNING...WHILE ANOTHER SHORT WAVE TROUGH WAS LOCATED IN MT. CONSIDERABLE CLOUDS AND SCATTERED CONVECTION/PCPN STRETCHED FROM THE MN ARROWHEAD/NWRN WI SWWD BACK TO NEAR THE ERN SD/ND BORDER. IN THE WAKE OF THIS LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WEAK OR ELEVATED DUE TO WEAK SHORTWAVE RIDGING/ STRENGTHENING CAPPING INVERSION. HOWEVER...DEEP LAYER SHEAR IN CLOUD BEARING LAYER AND MUCAPES AROUND 1500 J/KG MAY SUPPORT A FEW ELEVATED STORMS WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL INTO THE AFTERNOON HOURS. AS UPPER WAVE AND LARGE SCALE ASCENT APPROACHES FROM THE WEST THIS AFTERNOON...MODELS ARE FAIRLY CONSISTENT ON STORMS DEVELOPING NEAR REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN QUASI-STATIONARY FROM NRN SD EWD INTO CENTRAL MN. ALSO...A WEAK SURFACE LOW WAS LOCATED IN WRN SD AND SHOULD DRIFT EWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY INTO ERN SD. THE ENHANCED CONVERGENCE ALONG BOUNDARY ...ESPECIALLY AHEAD OF SURFACE LOW...AND DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION OF MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER FAVORS SURFACE BASED STORMS FORMING BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON. sections.text: WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY STRETCHED FROM THE ERN CAROLINAS WWD INTO NRN AL/MS. sections.text: DIURNAL HEATING COUPLED WITH MID LEVEL VORTICITY CENTER LOCATED ON WRN FLANK OF SUBTROPICAL RIDGE OVER ERN AZ...WILL LIKELY AID IN HIGH BASED AFTERNOON TSTMS. GIVEN 20-30 KT MID LEVEL SLY WINDS WITHIN DEEPLY MIXED/DRY BOUNDARY LAYER...A POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STRONG/GUSTY SURFACE WINDS. ..IMY/STOPPKOTTE.. 06/25/2010

sections.title: PART OF MID MO AND UPPER MS VALLEYS/WRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A SMALL SWD EXPANSION OF THE SLIGHT/MODERATE RISK AREAS HAS BEEN MADE WITH THIS OUTLOOK ISSUANCE FROM FAR NERN NEB ACROSS NRN AND CENTRAL IA....WHILE PORTIONS OF EAST CENTRAL MN /MILLE LACS REGION/ EWD INTO NRN/ERN WI HAVE BEEN REMOVED FROM THE SLIGHT RISK. THE SRN MODIFICATION IS DUE TO ONGOING STRONG DESTABILIZATION ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY WHICH IS EXPECTED TO AID IN EVENTUAL BACKBUILDING OF AN MCS THAT IS PROGGED TO DEVELOP BY EVENING OVER ERN SD/SRN MN. ALTHOUGH WLY FLOW ALOFT SHOULD SUPPORT AN ESEWD PROPAGATION OF THE MCS INTO PARTS OF WRN/SWRN WI AND NWRN IL TONIGHT...THE RESERVOIR OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY AND STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ INTO IA WILL FAVOR BACKBUILDING ALONG SWRN/SRN FLANK OF THE MCS. THESE TRENDS ARE SUPPORTED BY THE 12Z NAM/15Z HRRR. FARTHER N FROM MILLE LACS AREA OF MN INTO NRN/ERN WI...WEAKER INSTABILITY SHOULD LIMIT THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS THESE AREAS. FOR ADDITIONAL MESOSCALE DETAILS...REFER TO SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS 1121 /FOR WEST CENTRAL/SRN ND AND NRN SD/...1123 /FOR ERN SD...SRN MN...AND EXTREME NWRN IA/...AND SUBSEQUENT WATCHES/ DISCUSSIONS.

sections.title: SERN STATES WWD TO SERN OK AND CENTRAL/ERN TX
sections.text: SLIGHT RISK AREA HAS BEEN EXTENDED SWD INTO SRN GA/FAR NRN FL AND WWD INTO MORE OF NRN MS...GIVEN RECENT REGIONAL RADAR TRENDS OF ONGOING TSTM COVERAGE WITHIN A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /MLCAPE 3000-4000 J PER KG/. DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS THROUGH EARLY EVENING. 5 PERCENT HAIL/WIND PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED FARTHER WEST ACROSS PARTS OF NRN/ERN TX DUE TO TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY WITH ONGOING ACTIVITY WITHIN AN UNSTABLE/WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. ..PETERS.. 06/25/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT FRI JUN 25 2010/

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES REGION
sections.text: EARLY THIS EVENING A SW-NE ORIENTED CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM SWRN NEB NEWD INTO SERN SD. A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY STRETCHES ACROSS SRN MN. THE WARM SECTOR SOUTH OF THESE BOUNDARIES REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE WITH 3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE. THIS REGION ALSO RESIDES ALONG SRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER WLYS WITH 40-50 KT BULK SHEAR. MAIN FOCUS FOR SEVERE WEATHER WILL PERSIST WITH CLUSTER OF STORMS ACROSS SRN MN AS OF EARLY THIS EVENING. SUPERCELL MODES WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES HAS BEEN THE PRIMARY THREAT EARLY THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...STORMS ARE BEGINNING TO CONSOLIDATE INTO A LINE OVER SRN MN. STORMS WILL EVENTUALLY GROW UPSCALE TO AN MCS AND FORWARD PROPAGATE SEWD INTO NRN IA AND SRN WI PROMOTED BY THE STRENGTHENING SWLY LOW LEVEL JET INTERACTING WITH THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW. THOUGH THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL PERSIST INTO THE EVENING...THE PRIMARY THREAT IS EXPECTED TO TRANSITION DAMAGING WIND.

sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS
sections.text: OTHER SEVERE STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER CNTRL NEB ALONG THE SW-NE ORIENTED BOUNDARY...AND ADDITIONAL SEVERE STORMS COULD DEVELOP INTO SERN SD DUE TO POTENTIAL FOR BACKBUILDING ALONG THE WRN PORTIONS OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AS THE LOW LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS. FARTHER NORTH MORE ISOLATED STORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG A CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY FROM NWRN THROUGH SERN ND. WV IMAGERY INDICATES A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CRESTING UPPER RIDGE AND MOVING INTO SRN MANITOBA WHICH MAY HELP TO SUSTAIN ACTIVITY ACROSS NRN ND THROUGH THE EVENING. OTHER STORMS CONTINUE TO SPREAD OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND ARE MOVING INTO ERN MT. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY COULD INTENSIFY AS IT MOVES INTO RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. OVERALL...COVERAGE OF STORMS AND SEVERE WEATHER OVER MOST OF THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED DUE TO WEAK FORCING ALONG WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING. ..DIAL.. 06/26/2010
